Now actually I was invested from this song after finding the meaning of the song and this what tells me, “Soulmate” by Cocktail is a heartfelt song about timeless, unconditional love — the kind that feels destined and unbreakable. Its lyrics speak of finding the one person who completes you, who makes the world stop with just a glance, and who remains by your side through every joy and hardship. It’s a story of two souls bound by fate, promising to love, protect, and walk together no matter where life leads. More than just a love song, it’s a vow of eternal devotion — a gentle reminder that true soulmates never part, not even when time moves on. 💙

Likeee who woulddd ever move on from thiss causeee frrr it leads me to think about the RING. I'm still wondering about the ring from chemistry test cause it was not common (as far as I've remembered) to give one to your partners from then on and the fact that it has never been taken off...likeee this is something more than just a ring but a symbol of the connection, trust, and unspoken affection — something that goes beyond simple gestures or words. It represents a bond that’s genuine and meaningful, much like the message in “Soulmate” by Cocktail — a promise of loyalty, care, and togetherness. And the ring mirrors that sentiment — a quiet yet powerful reminder that some connections are simply meant to be. 💙 It was just wholesome frrr and the fact that Ohm indeed came to care for him when his sick is a true value that both are destined for each other huhuhu they really are true fire signs — Sagittarius and Aries — a combo that’s all passion, intensity, and pure energy...ahhh and no wonder everything about OhmPoon feels so magnetic — they’re literally two flames that burn brighter together. 🔥 I'm crying 😭
